note: v3 GROUNDED repaint 2026-10-21: one café ground floor on a single terracotta floor; every figure sits on a chair, stands on the floor or sits on the zinc counter at real size. Wooden column in the middle: feminine words left (street door, terrace window, front tables), masculine right (zinc counter, giraffe window, back tables, stairs up). Items kept >=6% from every edge. One box per item. Round 4 (2026-10-21 15:30): the front-left table is a grown-up table (a grey-haired lady in a green cardigan with the ice-cream glass; the beer with its bee and the ashtray with one unlit cigarette sit there, nobody drinking or smoking); the extra boy at the poodle's table was removed. Neutral daylight colour grade (tools/neutralize.py; warm original kept as base_warm_v3.jpg).

items.label: la glace
items.scene: A grey-haired lady in a green cardigan happily licks an ICE CREAM piled high in a tall GLASS (GLAHS).

items.label: la bière
items.scene: A BEE in the AIR (BYEHR) hovers over a frothy glass of BEER on the green-cardigan lady's grown-up table; nobody drinks it.

items.label: la cigarette
items.scene: Same as English 'cigarette' (said see-gah-REHT): one unlit CIGARETTE lies in the ashtray on the green-cardigan lady's grown-up table; nobody smokes it.

items.label: la terrasse
items.scene: Same as English 'terrace' (said teh-RAHS): through the open window, two friends chat at a sunny café TERRACE table under a parasol.

items.label: la soif
items.scene: A SUAVE fox in a bow tie (SWAHF) is dying of THIRST, tongue out, reaching for a water jug.

items.label: la boisson
items.scene: A BOY sings a SONG (bwah-SOHN) into a bottle of fizzy DRINK as if it were a microphone.

items.label: la tasse
items.scene: A juggler TOSSES (TAHS) a CUP and saucer high in the air.

items.label: le café
items.scene: Same as English 'café' (said kah-FAY): a sleepy owl perched on the zinc bar sips a tiny cup of black COFFEE to stay awake.

items.label: le thé
items.scene: A ginger cat sitting on the bar swishes its long TAIL (TAY) down the counter side, its cup of TEA by its paw.

items.label: le bar
items.scene: Same as English 'bar' (said BAHR): the zinc BAR counter is polished so bright it gleams like one giant silver BAR.

items.label: le plateau
items.scene: A waitress gasps 'OH!' as her TRAY of flat ('PLAT') plates wobbles (plah-TOH).

items.label: le jus
items.scene: A ZOO giraffe (ZHEW) pokes its head in through the window to sip orange JUICE through a very long straw.

items.label: l'apéritif
items.scene: Same as English 'aperitif' (said ah-pay-ree-TEEF): a white goose sits at a little table with its small pre-dinner APERITIF glass and a bowl of olives.

items.label: le bistrot
items.scene: Same as English 'bistro', silent t (bees-TROH): a curly poodle sits at its favourite little BISTRO table by the stairs, sipping coffee.

items.label: le tilleul
items.scene: Beside a chocolate YULE log, granny pours LIME-BLOSSOM TEA (tee-YUHL), a sprig of yellow linden flowers on her table.
